title: El viaje de Colón
goal: Read the real story of Columbus's 1492 voyage, from the fall of Constantinople to why the continent was named after someone else entirely.
grammar: Narración histórica: pretérito indefinido e imperfecto

items: Explain why the Iberian monarchies looked for sea routes to Asia after the fall of Constantinople in 1453.
Describe who first sighted land on 12 October 1492 and where the ships landed.
Explain why Columbus called the people he met 'indios'.
Explain why the continent is called 'América' and not 'Colombia'.
Use the preterite to narrate a sequence of historical events.
